2480:     <html:details id="attachmentArea">
2481:       <html:summary>
2482:         <!-- Hide from accessibility tree since this is only used for a brief
2483:            - animation effect. -->
2484:         <html:span id="newAttachmentIndicator" aria-hidden="hidden"></html:span>
2485:         <html:img id="attachmentToggle"
2486:                   src="chrome://messenger/skin/icons/new/nav-down-sm.svg"
2487:                   alt="" />
2488:         <html:span id="attachmentBucketCount"></html:span>
2489:         <html:span id="attachmentBucketSize" role="note"></html:span>
2490:       </html:summary>
2491: 
2492:       <richlistbox is="attachment-list" id="attachmentBucket"
2493:                    aria-describedby="attachmentBucketCount"
2494:                    class="attachmentList"
2495:                    disableonsend="true"
2496:                    seltype="multiple"
2497:                    flex="1"
2498:                    role="listbox"
2499:                    context="msgComposeAttachmentListContext"
2500:                    itemcontext="msgComposeAttachmentItemContext"
2501:                    onclick="attachmentBucketOnClick(event);"
2502:                    onkeypress="attachmentBucketOnKeyPress(event);"
2503:                    onselect="attachmentBucketOnSelect();"
2504:                    ondragstart="attachmentBucketDNDObserver.onDragStart(event);"
2505:                    ondragover="envelopeDragObserver.onDragOver(event);"
2506:                    ondrop="envelopeDragObserver.onDrop(event);"
2507:                    ondragleave="envelopeDragObserver.onDragLeave(event);"
2508:                    onblur="attachmentBucketOnBlur();"/>
2509:     </html:details>
2510:   </html:div>
2511:
